baggage-guidelines.Cabin or Carry-on Baggage: Air India lists a cabin bag size of 55 × 40 × 20 cm. The weight limit is 7 kg in Economy and Premium Economy, and 10 kg in Business and First. A small personal item must fit under the seat.
baggage-guidelines.Checked Baggage: Look for the allowance on your e-ticket. Air India publishes different allowances by route, fare and cabin. On a codeshare or a journey with more than one airline, check which carrier’s rules apply to your ticket.

customer-support.Submit a Help Request: For a specific trip problem or complaint, Air India provides a customer support request form. This guide cannot file a request on your behalf.
customer-support.Lost Items: For belongings left behind, Air India lists separate lost-item contacts. For a missing checked bag, use the baggage reporting process instead.

flight-status-info.Search by Flight Number: Enter your flight number and travel date to check departure and arrival updates. Air India also offers searches by booking reference or route.
flight-status-info.Supported Date Window: Air India’s status page covers two days before through two days after today. The lookup in this project only searches sample records.

online-checkin-info.Web Check-in Window: Air India’s dedicated page lists opening 48 hours before departure, with closing times of one hour for domestic and two hours for international flights. Its FAQ also contains a general 60-minute statement, so confirm the deadline for your trip.
online-checkin-info.Domestic Boarding Card: For eligible domestic trips, online check-in can issue a printable boarding pass. If you have checked baggage, allow time to drop it at the airport.
online-checkin-info.International Confirmation Slip: If online check-in issues a confirmation slip, take it to the airport counter for document verification and collection of your boarding pass.
online-checkin-info.Codeshare Eligibility: Air India’s dedicated page says its web check-in service is unavailable for codeshare flights. Confirm the process with the operating airline.
